name: Tir fo Thuinn

attributes.attribute: a name for the place of the fairies

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tir fo Thuinn is the land under the wave in Irish myth. It is one of the names of the Otherworld, the place of the fairies. The folk held that the sea and the lake hide the road to this realm. Cities stand on the bed of the water.

okr.objective: Set down Tir fo Thuinn as the land under the wave.
key_results: Gives the name the land under the wave
Marks it as a name of the fairy realm
Notes the land under the water
